简介:
Daniel Kabanda is a British actor based in Scotland, UK.
Daniel plays the role of cater waiter in the new Spider-Man Brand New Day, in cinemas July 31st
Daniel played the role of mark in the 2022 independent movie "Gaff" which he got praised for best co character at the EK Film festival
He has also played the role of subject 45 in the segment "Diet Phantasma" in the Horror film "V/H/S Halloween"
